messages.content: amar life e kono direction nai emon lagche recently, sob random feel hocche
Eta feeling ta specific kono ekta area te beshi, naki overall everything e?
overall e mone hoy, career, relationship, sob khane
Eto shob ekshathe directionless feel kora exhausting. Last kokhon nijer jonno kono goal ba ekscitement chilo, mone porche?
mone hoy onek din hoye gelo, kichu recall korte parchi na

That's actually a useful clue - it's not that direction disappeared overnight, it faded gradually without you noticing. Choto kono jinis diye shuru koro, ekta interest jeta halkabhabe explore korte iccha kore, boro life plan na bhebe.
